Every business has more than one axis.

Businesses face new challenges every day. Rising costs, inefficient workflows, untapped revenue opportunities and complex workforce structures can slow down business development.

ConsultAxis helps businesses review existing structures, improve operational processes and unlock their economic potential.

We combine commercial understanding with practical solutions. Rather than looking at individual areas in isolation, we consider how the key elements of a business work together.

Our ambition

More structure. Greater efficiency. More business potential.

Business Consulting

Five consulting areas for SMEs, retail and multi-site operations, service companies, hospitality, start-ups and international businesses. Each with a clear objective.

All business consulting services
  • APeople & Organisational OptimisationAlign people, tasks and responsibilities in an effective and practical way.
  • BSales & Revenue OptimisationBuild transparent and efficient sales structures that support sustainable revenue development.
  • CDocument & Process OptimisationReduce unnecessary administrative effort, improve transparency and establish clear workflows.
  • DOperational & Cost OptimisationHelp businesses use their financial and operational resources more consciously and efficiently.
  • EBusiness Development & Strategic ConsultingEstablish a clear business direction and a sustainable foundation for future development.

Real Estate Consulting

Independent, property-related consulting for private owners, buyers, investors and businesses.

  • Real estate market and location analyses
  • Economic property assessments and market price orientation
  • Review and structuring of property documents
  • Checks for completeness and currency
  • Identification of documentation gaps and inconsistencies
  • Preparation of property information and sales documentation
  • Preparing owners for a planned property sale
  • Support in compiling a professional property profile

Consulting only. ConsultAxis does not act as an estate agent or broker and does not arrange property transactions.

How we work

  1. 01

    Initial discussion and objectives

    We get to know your business and understand its challenges.

  2. 02

    Assessment of the current situation

    We review existing structures, workflows and relevant performance indicators.

  3. 03

    Development of an action plan

    We prepare tailored recommendations and practical measures.

  4. 04

    Implementation and support

    We assist with the agreed implementation activities.

  5. 05

    Review and continuous improvement

    We assess progress against the objectives and indicators defined at the start.
